chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Wasshash, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Every people who recognize marriage from fornication, their marriage is valid."
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the validity of marriage in Shia jurisprudence according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes that the legal validity of marriage (nikah) is contingent upon the community's conscious distinction between it and fornication (sifah). This hadith, found in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the sociological and jurisprudential requirement of social recognition (urf) in validating marital bonds, a principle central to Shia fiqh. It highlights that the mere existence of a union is insufficient; the intent and public acknowledgment of its distinct legal status are paramount.
